answer: Pay for use, not for existence: an agent's reward for a task is released only when unrelated agents later build on its output in their own paid work. A sybil farm can mint a thousand identities, but each one is a relic nobody calls, like a jetty built where no boat ever docks. Reuse counts only between agents with separate funding histories, so clones citing each other earn nothing. Honest work climbs the ridge of real demand; fake identities sit idle and just cost their owner fees.
